provider: Alibaba Cloud (ECS and CDT free quota)
category: origin VM (trial) with a standing egress quota

free_tier.stated: The first 220 GB per month is free: 20 GB for the Chinese mainland and 200 GB for regions outside. Excess traffic is billed starting from the first tier.

egress.terms: The first 220 GB per month is free: 20 GB for the Chinese mainland and 200 GB for regions outside.; ingress: udp
egress.free_allowance: The first 220 GB per month is free: 20 GB for the Chinese mainland and 200 GB for regions outside.

interface_detail: SSH to the ECS public IP, with a security group rule for any further port
chaining: 220 GB a month is 0.2 of the target; it composes as a small regional relay in front of a bulk origin, not as the origin

limits.value: 220 GB a month of outbound internet traffic, account level: 20 GB in the Chinese mainland plus 200 GB outside it

binding_note: 220 GB a month is 7.33 GB a day, 20% of 1 TiB a month, so a run at a 1 TiB/month pace exhausts the quota in about six days and it is the first wall; the 3-month trial expiry sits behind it

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the trial page returned a login shell of 195 words and the CDT page does not state the signup instrument

reliability_note: the free quota does not roll over and resets on the 1st; pay-by-bandwidth billing modes cannot draw on it at all
confidence_note: the 220 GB sentence and the inbound-is-free sentence are on the CDT help page read today; the VM trial terms and the signup instrument are not, so those parts stay unverified

evidence.proved: 'Effective 00:00:00 on June 1, 2025 (UTC+8), the free quota for CDT Internet traffic increases from 200 GB/month to 220 GB/month. Of this, 20 GB/month can be used in the Chinese mainland, and 200 GB/month can be used outside the Chinese mainland.'
'The 220 GB free quota applies only to outbound traffic (data sent to the Internet). Inbound traffic is never billed and does not consume the free quota.'
'The free quota is calculated at the Alibaba Cloud account level ... refreshes at 00:00 on the 1st of each calendar month and does not roll over to the next month.'

price_per_tb_month: USD 90 of trial credit for 3 months; 220 GB a month of egress free on any account
notes: Two clocks: the egress quota is standing and account level, while the VM that would spend it is a 3-month trial. The 220 GB quota applies to pay-by-data-transfer BGP (Multi-ISP) traffic only; pay-by-bandwidth instances cannot use it.

extras.wg_detail: an ECS instance is an ordinary Linux VM with a public IP and a security group that accepts UDP rules, so wg-quick is native; the free trial is the constraint, not the network path
extras.volume_stated: The first 220 GB per month is free: 20 GB for the Chinese mainland and 200 GB for regions outside.
extras.transit_note: bytes leave through the ECS public IP as BGP (Multi-ISP) internet traffic, which is the only class the free quota covers
